The '''1987–88 season''' was '''[[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]''''s 86th season in existence and the club's 57th consecutive season in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Overview==
Real Madrid finished the season as champions for the third season running, claiming the club's 23rd league title overall.<ref>{{cite news|publisher=[[El País]]|title=Fiesta madridista por el título y la despedida a Santillana|url=https://elpais.com/diario/1988/05/22/deportes/580255211_850215.html|language=es|date=22 May 1998}}</ref> ''Los Blancos'' finished 11 points ahead of the runners-up, that this time were [[Real Sociedad]].<ref>{{cite news|publisher=El País|title=Un título rácano en números|url=https://elpais.com/diario/1995/06/19/deportes/803512841_850215.html|language=es|date=19 June 1995}}</ref> However, Madrid lost to the Basque side in the [[1987–88 Copa del Rey|Copa del Rey]] semi-finals 0–5 on aggregate and were knocked out at the same stage of the [[1987–88 European Cup|European Cup]] by [[PSV Eindhoven]].
